content: ffprobe (FFmpeg project) reports container/stream/packet/frame level data via -show_format/-show_streams/-show_packets/-show_frames, JSON writer omits invalid fields; per-packet pts/dts/duration/size/keyframe flag; per-frame pts/dts/type/size plus closed_captions/film_grain when frame analysis enabled. No comparison/diff or pass-fail semantics; it is inspection only.
